dedupe_keys.name: teoco asset radio network planning and design tool

description: ASSET is a radio network planning and design tool for mobile operators, created by Aircom and now offered by TEOCO. It supports planning of GSM, UMTS, LTE and 5G NR networks, and traditional, virtualised, centralised and Open RAN architectures with equipment from several vendors, so that existing and new network layers can be planned together. Its propagation modelling includes an integrated ray-tracing model and 5G NR propagation models with high-resolution 3D coverage simulation using 3D clutter data, and a Monte Carlo simulator refines traffic modelling when comparing network scenarios. Automation features cover site placement, physical cell identity (PCI), random access channel (RACH) and neighbour planning and wider design optimisation, and the tool also handles RF coverage and capacity planning, cell parameter configuration, electromagnetic field (EMF) level analysis and an API library for integration with operations and business support systems. Coverage: worldwide use by operators. Format and access: commercial software from TEOCO, sold by licence. Caveats: proprietary; the vendor site refused automated requests, so this description relies on a fetched summary of the product page. Simulation uses: capacity planning and optimisation of radio access networks, and modelling how site outages change coverage and load on neighbouring cells. Related records: Forsk Atoll, Infovista Planet and Altair WinProp are comparable planning suites.
